# Visual Smash

> Visual Smash is a boutique creative agency based in the San Francisco Bay Area. Founded in 2004, we deliver brand identity, UX design, web design, AI-powered creative, marketing automation, and Microsoft Power Platform solutions for Fortune 500 companies and ambitious startups.

## About
- Name: Visual Smash
- Founded: 2004
- Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California, USA
- Contact: visualsmash@gmail.com
- Site: https://visualsmash.lovable.app

## What We Do
- Brand Identity & Visual Systems
- User Experience (UX) Design & Research
- Web Design & Front-End Development
- AI-Powered Creative & Prompt Engineering
- Microsoft Power Automate workflows
- AI Agents with Microsoft 365 Copilot Studio
- Technical Marketing, Analytics, and Marketing Automation
- Catalog, Print, Packaging, and Advertising Design

## Industries Served
Technology, Luxury Real Estate, Fashion & Retail, Financial Services, Healthcare, Construction, Energy, Legal, Education, Logistics.
